actions.calcom_add_attendee.description: Add an additional attendee to an existing Cal.com booking.
actions.calcom_add_attendee.props.time_z: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Get valid values from List Timezones.
actions.calcom_cancel_booking.descriptio: Cancel an active Cal.com booking by its uid.
actions.calcom_confirm_booking.descripti: Confirm a Cal.com booking that is pending host confirmation.
actions.calcom_create_booking.descriptio: Book a Cal.com event type at a specific start time for one attendee.
actions.calcom_create_booking.props.atte: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Get valid values from List Timezones.
actions.calcom_create_booking.props.even: Get this from List Event Types.
actions.calcom_create_booking.props.leng: Only for event types offering multiple possible durations.
actions.calcom_create_booking.props.star: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC, e.g. 2026-03-05T15:00:00Z. Get a valid value from Get Available Slots.
actions.calcom_create_event_type.descrip: Create a new Cal.com event type.
actions.calcom_create_event_type.props.a: Advanced event-type fields not listed above, as a JSON object matching the Cal.com v2 Create Event Type request body (e.g. {"bookingLimitsCount": {...}}).
actions.calcom_create_event_type.props.s: Assign a different availability schedule than the owner's default one. Get this from List Schedules.
URL-safe identifier for the event type, must be unique.
actions.calcom_create_schedule.props.ava: Array of weekly availability blocks, e.g. [{"days": ["Monday", "Tuesday"], "startTime": "09:00", "endTime": "17:00"}]. Leave empty for Cal.com's default Mon-Fri 9-17 pattern.
actions.calcom_create_schedule.props.is_: Each user has exactly one default schedule; setting this replaces it.
actions.calcom_create_schedule.props.tim: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Get valid values from List Timezones.
actions.calcom_decline_booking.descripti: Decline a Cal.com booking that is pending host confirmation.
actions.calcom_delete_event_type.descrip: Permanently delete a Cal.com event type by id.
actions.calcom_delete_event_type.props.e: Get this from List Event Types.
actions.calcom_delete_schedule.descripti: Permanently delete an availability schedule by id.
actions.calcom_get_available_slots.descr: Find bookable time slots for a Cal.com event type within a time range.
actions.calcom_get_available_slots.props: Only for event types offering multiple possible durations.
ISO 8601 timestamp for the end of the search range.
Get this from List Event Types.
ISO 8601 timestamp for the beginning of the search range.
IANA timezone the returned slots are expressed in.
actions.calcom_get_booking.description: Get the full details of a single Cal.com booking by its uid, including its attendees.
actions.calcom_get_default_schedule.desc: Get the connected user's default availability schedule.
actions.calcom_get_event_type.descriptio: Get the full configuration of a single Cal.com event type by id.
actions.calcom_get_event_type.props.even: Get this from List Event Types.
actions.calcom_get_my_profile.descriptio: Get the profile of the connected Cal.com user.
actions.calcom_get_schedule.description: Get the full details of one availability schedule by id.
actions.calcom_list_bookings.description: Search Cal.com bookings by status, attendee, event type or date range.
actions.calcom_list_bookings.props.after: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only bookings starting after this time.
actions.calcom_list_bookings.props.befor: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only bookings ending before this time.
actions.calcom_list_bookings.props.curso: Pass the cursor from a previous call to get the next page.
actions.calcom_list_event_types.descript: List Cal.com event types, optionally filtered by owner.
actions.calcom_list_event_types.props.ev: Filter to the event type with this exact slug. Requires Username to be set too.
actions.calcom_list_event_types.props.or: Only used together with Username / Event Slug when booking through an organization.
actions.calcom_list_event_types.props.us: Only event types owned by this Cal.com username. Leave empty to list your own.
actions.calcom_list_schedules.descriptio: List all of the connected user's availability schedules.
actions.calcom_list_teams.description: List the teams the connected Cal.com user belongs to.
actions.calcom_list_timezones.descriptio: List valid IANA timezone strings Cal.com accepts.
actions.calcom_mark_booking_no_show.desc: Mark the host and/or a specific attendee absent for a Cal.com booking.
actions.calcom_mark_booking_no_show.prop: Only used together with Attendee Email. Defaults to Yes.
Leave empty to only set Host Absent.
actions.calcom_reschedule_booking.descri: Move a Cal.com booking to a new start time.
actions.calcom_update_event_type.descrip: Update an existing Cal.com event type. Only the fields you set are changed.
actions.calcom_update_event_type.props.a: Advanced event-type fields not listed above, as a JSON object matching the Cal.com v2 Update Event Type request body (e.g. {"bookingLimitsCount": {...}}).
actions.calcom_update_event_type.props.e: Get this from List Event Types.
actions.calcom_update_event_type.props.h: Leave unset to keep the current visibility.
actions.calcom_update_event_type.props.s: Assign a different availability schedule than the owner's default one. Get this from List Schedules.
actions.calcom_update_my_profile.descrip: Update the connected Cal.com user's own profile. Only the fields you set are changed.
actions.calcom_update_my_profile.props.t: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Get valid values from List Timezones.
actions.calcom_update_schedule.descripti: Update an existing availability schedule. Only the fields you set are changed.
actions.calcom_update_schedule.props.ava: If set, replaces the entire weekly availability array, e.g. [{"days": ["Monday"], "startTime": "09:00", "endTime": "17:00"}].
actions.calcom_update_schedule.props.is_: Leave unset to keep the current default schedule unchanged.
actions.calcom_update_schedule.props.ove: If set, replaces the entire date-overrides array, e.g. [{"date": "2026-05-20", "startTime": "12:00", "endTime": "13:00"}].
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Add cal-api-version (2026-05-01 for /bookings). Auth is added for you.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open [Settings → Developer → API Keys](https://app.cal.com/settings/developer/api-keys) in Cal.com.
2. Create a new key and choose when it expires.
3. Copy the key (it starts with `cal_`) and paste it here.
triggers.BOOKING_CANCELLED.description: Triggers when a Cal.com booking is cancelled.
triggers.BOOKING_CANCELLED.props.webhook: This webhook is added to your Cal.com account when you publish the flow and removed when you turn it off. It fires for bookings on the account that owns the API key.
triggers.BOOKING_CREATED.description: Triggers when someone books a meeting with you on Cal.com.
triggers.BOOKING_CREATED.props.webhook_i: This webhook is added to your Cal.com account when you publish the flow and removed when you turn it off. It fires for bookings on the account that owns the API key.
triggers.BOOKING_RESCHEDULED.description: Triggers when a Cal.com booking is moved to a new time.
triggers.BOOKING_RESCHEDULED.props.webho: This webhook is added to your Cal.com account when you publish the flow and removed when you turn it off. It fires for bookings on the account that owns the API key.
